label: Martial percentage
summary: Changes the character's Martial skill by a percentage.
details: The value is a percentage, not a flat amount, and can be negative. Works on a character.

label: Martial per influence level
summary: Adds Martial skill for each influence level the character has.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial per influence level', the value is added once per level, so a higher level gives more. The game does not explain influence levels here. Works on a character.

label: Martial per merit level
summary: Adds Martial skill for each merit level the character has.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial per merit level', the value is added once per level, so a higher level gives more. The game does not explain merit levels here. Works on a character.

label: Martial per piety level
summary: Adds Martial skill for each piety level the character has.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial per piety level', the value is added once per level, so a higher level gives more. Works on a character.

label: Martial per prestige level
summary: Adds Martial skill for each prestige level the character has.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial per prestige level', the value is added once per level, so a higher level gives more. Works on a character.

label: Martial per stress level
summary: Adds Martial skill for each stress level the character has.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial per stress level', the value is added once per level. A negative value would make it a penalty that grows with stress. Works on a character.

label: Martial scheme speed
summary: Changes the phase duration of the character's Martial schemes, which the game labels 'Martial scheme speed'.
details: Going by that label, it applies to schemes that use the Martial skill. Whether a higher value makes them faster or slower is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Martial scheme resistance
summary: Changes the character's resistance to Martial schemes.
details: Going by the game's label 'Martial scheme resistance', it works against schemes that use the Martial skill. The game gives no more detail. Works on a character.

label: Max schemes of a type
summary: Adds to how many schemes of one given type the character can run at the same time.
details: `$SCHEME_TYPE$` stands for the key of a scheme type; for example `max_murder_schemes_add` for the scheme type `murder` (vanilla uses that key). The `_add` ending means a flat number. The game gives no text for this key itself. Works on a character.

label: Maximum combat roll
summary: Changes the highest combat roll, which the game labels 'Maximum combat roll'.
details: Vanilla sets the minimum counterpart as small flat numbers (1, 2) on court positions, so this is likely a flat number too. Going by its name, it caps the top of the roll range. Works on a character.

label: Max contract schemes
summary: Adds to how many contract schemes the character can run at once.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat number, which can be negative. Contract is one of the scheme categories in vanilla's scheme type files. Works on a character.

label: Max hostile schemes
summary: Adds to how many hostile schemes the character can run at once.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat number, which can be negative. Hostile is one of the scheme categories in vanilla's scheme type files. Works on a character.

label: Army loot capacity
summary: Changes by a percentage the loot capacity the game labels 'Army loot capacity'.
details: The value is a percentage and can be negative. Presumably it concerns the character's armies, as the label says. Works on a character.

label: Max migration distance
summary: Changes by a percentage the maximum migration distance.
details: The value is a percentage and can be negative. The game gives no more detail on what migrates. Works on a character.

label: Max personal schemes
summary: Adds to how many personal schemes the character can run at once.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat number, which can be negative. Personal is one of the scheme categories in vanilla's scheme type files. Works on a character.

label: Max political schemes
summary: Adds to how many political schemes the character can run at once.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat number, which can be negative. Political is one of the scheme categories in vanilla's scheme type files. Works on a character.

label: Max men-at-arms regiments
summary: Changes how many men-at-arms regiments the character can have.
details: The game labels it 'Max men-at-arms regiments'. The key has no `_add` or `_mult` ending, so the kind of value is not documented. Compare men_at_arms_title_cap, which has the matching label for title regiments. Works on a character.

label: Men-at-arms regiment size
summary: Changes the size of the character's men-at-arms regiments.
details: The game labels it 'Size of men-at-arms regiments'. The kind of value is not documented. Compare men_at_arms_title_limit, which has the matching label for title regiments. Works on a character.

label: Men-at-arms maintenance
summary: Changes the maintenance of the character's men-at-arms.
details: The game labels it 'Men-at-arms maintenance'. Going by the word maintenance, a higher value means higher upkeep. The kind of value is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Maintenance per dread
summary: Changes men-at-arms maintenance by a percentage per point of the character's dread.
details: Dread is how much others fear the character. The percentage grows with the amount of dread. Works on a character.

label: Men-at-arms recruitment cost
summary: Changes the recruitment cost of men-at-arms for the character.
details: The game labels it 'Men-at-arms recruitment cost'. Going by the word cost, a higher value means dearer recruiting. The kind of value is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Max title men-at-arms regiments
summary: Changes how many title-bound men-at-arms regiments the character can have.
details: The game labels it 'Max title men-at-arms regiments'. The key has no `_add` or `_mult` ending, so the kind of value is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Title men-at-arms regiment size
summary: Changes the size of the character's title-bound men-at-arms regiments.
details: The game labels it 'Size of title men-at-arms regiments'. The kind of value is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Mercenary count
summary: Changes by a percentage the mercenary count, as a culture modifier.
details: The game has no label for it. It is the only key here that works on a culture, not a character. What exactly is counted is not documented.

label: Mercenary hire cost
summary: Changes by a flat amount what it costs the character to hire mercenaries.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat amount. Going by the word cost, a positive value makes hiring dearer. Works on a character.

label: Mercenary hire cost percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage what it costs the character to hire mercenaries.
details: The game shows the same name as for the flat version. The percentage form scales the cost, the flat form adds to it. Works on a character.

label: Mercenary hire duration
summary: Changes by a percentage how long it takes the character to hire mercenaries.
details: The game labels it 'Mercenary hire duration'. Going by that, a negative value shortens it. Works on a character.

label: Merit level impact
summary: Changes by a percentage the impact of the character's merit level.
details: The game labels it 'Merit level impact'. What the impact covers is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Merit rewards
summary: Changes by a percentage the standalone merit gains of the character.
details: The game labels it 'Merit rewards'. 'Standalone' in the key suggests merit that comes apart from the monthly flow, but the game does not say. Works on a character.

label: Merit loss
summary: Changes by a percentage the standalone merit losses of the character.
details: The game labels it 'Merit loss'. 'Standalone' in the key suggests losses apart from the monthly flow, but the game does not say. Works on a character.

label: Minimum combat roll
summary: Changes the lowest combat roll, which the game labels 'Minimum combat roll'.
details: Vanilla uses it on court positions with small flat numbers (1 to 2). Going by its name, it lifts the bottom of the roll range. Works on a character.

label: Monthly lifestyle XP
summary: Adds experience each month to one given lifestyle's track.
details: `$LIFESTYLE$` stands for the key of a lifestyle, such as `diplomacy_lifestyle` (common/lifestyles): `monthly_diplomacy_lifestyle_xp_gain_add`. The `_add` ending means a flat amount per month. Works on a character.

label: Monthly lifestyle XP percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly experience one given lifestyle's track gains.
details: `$LIFESTYLE$` stands for the key of a lifestyle, such as `diplomacy_lifestyle` (common/lifestyles): `monthly_diplomacy_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult`, a key vanilla uses. Works on a character.

label: Barter goods
summary: Adds barter goods each month.
details: The game labels it 'Barter goods'; it does not explain them here. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Monthly barter goods percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the barter goods gained each month.
details: Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: County control decline, flat
summary: Adds to how much county control falls each month.
details: County control is how firmly the holder controls the county. The `_add` ending means a flat amount per month. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control decline, flat, barons
summary: Adds to the monthly fall in county control, also for holders who are only barons.
details: The name suggests the plain version skips barons and this one does not. The game does not say so. Works on a character.

label: Control decline at war, flat
summary: Adds to the monthly fall in county control while at war.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat amount per month. The war condition comes from the name only. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control decline at war, factor
summary: Scales the monthly fall in county control while at war.
details: The `_factor` ending means a multiplier, not a flat amount. The war condition comes from the name only. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control decline
summary: Scales how fast county control falls each month.
details: The `_factor` ending means a multiplier, not a flat amount. The game labels it 'Control Decline'. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control decline factor, barons
summary: Scales the monthly fall in county control, also for holders who are only barons.
details: The game gives it the same text as the plain factor. The name suggests the plain version skips barons, but the game does not say so. Works on a character.

label: County control growth, flat
summary: Adds to how much county control grows each month.
details: County control is how firmly the holder controls the county. The `_add` ending means a flat amount per month. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control growth, flat, barons
summary: Adds to the monthly growth of county control, also for holders who are only barons.
details: The name suggests the plain version skips barons and this one does not. The game does not say so. Works on a character.

label: Control growth at war, flat
summary: Adds to the monthly growth of county control while at war.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat amount per month. The war condition comes from the name only. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control growth at war, factor
summary: Scales the monthly growth of county control while at war.
details: The `_factor` ending means a multiplier, not a flat amount. The war condition comes from the name only. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control growth
summary: Scales how fast county control grows each month.
details: The `_factor` ending means a multiplier, not a flat amount. The game labels it 'Control Growth'. Works on a character, a province and a county.

label: Control growth factor, barons
summary: Scales the monthly growth of county control, also for holders who are only barons.
details: The game gives it the same text as the plain factor. The name suggests the plain version skips barons, but the game does not say so. Works on a character.

label: Monthly court grandeur change
summary: Adds a flat amount to how the character's court grandeur changes each month.
details: Court grandeur is how impressive the character's court is. A negative value pulls it down. Works on a character.

label: Court grandeur change percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage how the character's court grandeur changes each month.
details: The game gives it the same text as the flat version. Works on a character.

label: Monthly dread
summary: Adds dread to the character each month.
details: Dread is how much others fear the character. A negative value takes dread away. Works on a character.

label: Monthly dynasty prestige
summary: Adds dynasty prestige each month.
details: Dynasty prestige is the standing of the character's dynasty. A negative value takes it away. Works on a character.

label: Dynasty prestige percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the dynasty prestige gained each month.
details: Works on a character.

label: Monthly income
summary: Adds gold income each month.
details: The game labels it with the tax term. A negative value lowers income. Works on a character and a province.

label: Income from herd
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly income that comes from herd.
details: The game labels it 'Monthly income from herd'; it does not explain herd here. Works on a character.

label: Monthly income percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the character's monthly income.
details: A negative value lowers income. Works on a character.

label: Income per piety level
summary: Adds income each month for each piety level.
details: The game has no label for it. It works only on a province. Which character's piety level counts is not documented, and neither is whether the value is flat.

label: Income per stress level
summary: Adds income each month for each stress level the character has.
details: The `_add` ending means a flat amount, applied once per level. A negative value makes it a cost. Works on a character.

label: Income per stress level percent
summary: Changes monthly income by a percentage for each stress level the character has.
details: The percentage is applied once per level, going by the 'per' in the label. Works on a character.

label: Monthly influence
summary: Adds influence to the character each month.
details: A negative value takes influence away. Works on a character.

label: Influence percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the influence the character gains each month.
details: Works on a character.

label: Monthly legitimacy
summary: Adds legitimacy to the character each month.
details: The game has no label for it. The `_add` ending means a flat amount; a negative value takes legitimacy away. Works on a character.

label: Monthly lifestyle experience, flat
summary: Adds a flat amount of lifestyle experience each month.
details: The game shows the percentage version's text for it. Which lifestyle gets the experience is not documented; the template keys with a lifestyle name target one. Works on a character.

label: Monthly lifestyle experience
summary: Changes by a percentage the lifestyle experience the character gains each month.
details: Works on a character.

label: Monthly merit
summary: Adds merit to the character each month.
details: A negative value takes merit away. Works on a character.

label: Merit percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the merit the character gains each month.
details: Works on a character.

label: Merit per tax paid to liege
summary: Adds merit each month in proportion to the total tax the character pays to their liege.
details: The more tax is paid up, the more merit. Works on a character.

label: Merit per title men-at-arms cost
summary: Adds merit each month in proportion to the base recruitment cost of title men-at-arms.
details: Costlier regiments give more merit. The game's label speaks of title men-at-arms in general. Works on a character.

label: Monthly piety
summary: Adds piety to the character each month.
details: A negative value takes piety away. Works on a character.

label: Piety from buildings
summary: Changes by a percentage the monthly piety that comes from buildings.
details: Works on a character.

label: Monthly piety percentage
summary: Changes by a percentage the piety the character gains each month.
details: Works on a character.

label: Piety per court position
summary: Adds piety each month for each court position.
details: The value is added once per position. The game's label does not say whether it counts positions the character fills or positions at their court. Works on a character.

label: Piety per court position percent
summary: Changes monthly piety gain by a percentage for each court position.
details: The percentage is applied once per position. The game's label does not say whose positions count. Works on a character.

label: Piety per dread
summary: Adds piety each month for each point of the character's dread.
details: Dread is how much others fear the character. Works on a character.

label: Piety per dread percent
summary: Changes monthly piety gain by a percentage for each point of the character's dread.
details: Works on a character.

label: Piety per powerful vassal on council
summary: Adds piety each month for each powerful vassal on the character's council.
details: The value is added once per such vassal. The game's label does not say how 'happy' counts; the key name suggests only content ones, but that is not documented. Works on a character.

label: Piety per council vassal, percent
summary: Changes monthly piety gain by a percentage for each powerful vassal on the character's council.
details: The percentage is applied once per such vassal. The key name suggests only happy ones count, but the game does not say so. Works on a character.

label: Piety per knight
summary: Adds piety each month for each knight.
details: The value is added once per knight. The game's label does not say whose knights count. Works on a character.

label: Piety per knight percent
summary: Changes monthly piety gain by a percentage for each knight.
details: The percentage is applied once per knight. The game's label does not say whose knights count. Works on a character.

label: Piety per legitimacy level
summary: Adds piety each month for each legitimacy level the character has.
details: The value is added once per level, so a higher level gives more. Works on a character.

label: Piety per legitimacy percent
summary: Changes monthly piety gain by a percentage for each legitimacy level the character has.
details: The percentage is applied once per level. Works on a character.
